display_long_description:
GoalieXR transforms your real-world space into a high-stakes soccer arena. Built for Meta Quest’s Mixed Reality capabilities, this immersive experience puts you in the goalkeeper’s gloves—dodging, diving, and catching blazing-fast balls right in your living room.

🏠 Mixed Reality Gameplay

Your physical environment becomes the pitch

Balls curve, dip, and rocket toward you from dynamic angles

Precision hand tracking delivers lifelike saves and reactions

🎮 Features

Adaptive difficulty that scales with your reflexes

Global leaderboards to challenge friends and rivals

Replay mode for influencer-ready highlight clips

Campaign overlays for viral launch strategies

Whether you're training your instincts or showcasing your skills, GoalieXR delivers the thrill of elite goalkeeping—right where you stand.
